one_line: This is a historical event-planning discussion, not an actionable solicitation, and only the sanitation portion overlaps with Temporary 123’s services.
scope: The Water Street event in Eau Claire, Wisconsin, involved bands, stage rental, professional production, art, promotion, and sanitation. The only clear rental opportunity within our scope was five regular portable toilets and one handwashing station, for which the organizer already had a vendor quote.

Wisconsin falls within our stated nationwide service area.
